name: Square Hole add-on catalog, format 2
decision: F55 carried to format 2; CQ11 applies F119-F123 and ADR-0017 Amendment 3. Format 1 and box 0 stay unchanged.
encoding: A BoxSpec carries `addOns` as (uint16 id, bytes params), as format 1's. params must be exactly abi.encode(<the add-on's parameter tuple>) in the order listed: canonical offsets, zero padding, no trailing bytes, each value inside its type. Canonical means re-encode and compare bytes, as box-spec.v2.json's wire format: a blob that does not decode, or decodes and re-encodes to other bytes, is ADD_ON_PARAMS_MALFORMED. An add-on without parameters carries empty params (0x).
Ids ascend in the list; an add-on marked repeatable may appear more than once in a row, others at most once. At most MAX_ADD_ONS entries (TOO_MANY_ADD_ONS).
Field ids in a verdict: 100 x add-on id for the add-on itself, 100 x id + i + 1 for its i-th parameter.

Parameter checks as format 1's: strings by their rule and length; uint `min`/`max` (OUT_OF_RANGE), where `max` may name a core field ({ "field": "n" }); `allowed`, a preset list (NOT_A_MEMBER); `enum`, a member of an enum below (NOT_A_MEMBER); a `bytes32[]` holds at most `maxItems` items (LENGTH_OUT_OF_RANGE), each non-zero with `nonZeroItems` (ZERO_VALUE).

Order of an entry's checks: listed here (ADD_ON_UNKNOWN at field 29; ids 2 and 5 are format 1's only, `notInFormat2`), not `reserved` and offered by the fixed release menu (ADD_ON_NOT_AVAILABLE at 100 x id), its `boxTypes` (ADD_ON_CONFLICT), its params (decoding: ADD_ON_PARAMS_MALFORMED; then each parameter), its `requires`.

`contract` means the add-on needs a contract at creation: tickets (1), the core income inbox (4), starter loader (8). Every box has the income inbox even without add-on 4. There are no plug-in clones or recipe gas budgets in this release.

members.name: FEE_HANDLING
members.note: Royalties in P are held until graduation, then split as buyers' fees: 2/15 FIT, 1/15 platform, 2/15 pool, 10/15 by the buyers' choice. A holders choice sends unearned money to the pool (F109). An Items choice follows the buyers inside policy and equal own-item weights (S1). The inbox offers listed coins for P on CoW; one that does not sell for thirty days, and other non-P coins, are claimed in kind.

members.name: CREATOR
members.note: Reserved wire value, refused for new RC6 boxes. The inbox offers listed coins for P on CoW; one that does not sell for thirty days, and other non-P coins, are claimed in kind.

members.name: POOL_DEPTH
members.note: Reserved wire value, refused for new RC6 boxes. The inbox offers listed coins for P on CoW; one that does not sell for thirty days, and other non-P coins, are claimed in kind.

addOns.title: Placeholders: tickets during the curve, hidden art revealed by draws
addOns.status: Offered in M1 (box-spec-v2-draft.md § 6): unchanged from format 1 (BoxSpecV1.sol:538-562). Its tickets are a contract at creation.

params.name: hiddenDescription
params.what: A hidden item's description in tokenURI

params.name: hiddenSvg
params.what: A hidden item's (and the ticket's) picture, inline SVG; loaded with the table after creation (ADR-0017 § 6)

requires.why: Placeholders open into hidden items; an open-art box has nothing hidden to draw.

addOns.title: Edition specials: named series of special items, shown as counts
addOns.status: Offered in M1: unchanged from format 1 (BoxSpecV1.sol:574-587). Data, not code.

params.name: label
params.what: The series' name, as the site shows it

params.name: count
params.what: How many items belong to the series (at most n)

addOns.title: Royalties: voluntary ERC-2981 income for the box
addOns.status: RC6: royalties use the box fee setup through its core income inbox. CoW sells eligible listed foreign coins for P; every royalty box explicitly names its in-kind payee.

params.name: bps
params.what: The ERC-2981 rate in basis points: 0, 1, 2.5 or 5% (unchanged, BoxSpecV1.sol:598)

params.name: destination
params.what: The box fee setup (1); former creator-only and pool-only destinations are not admitted.

routing.source: RC6 Option 1, F137, F138 and R53 G-J. P uses the box fee setup; the inbox offers listed coins for P on CoW, and one that does not sell waits thirty days for in-kind exit. Failed-box foreign coins exit in kind.

addOns.title: Collection page: banner, teasers and link (contractURI, ERC-7572)
addOns.status: Offered in M1: unchanged from format 1 (BoxSpecV1.sol:622-637).

params.name: teaserSha256s
params.what: Up to 4 teaser pictures by sha256, shown by the site only

addOns.title: Collection list: fixed tiers and an optional add-only curator
addOns.status: M2: SHOP only. Empty params; the sole list, tiers, curator and presets are in canonical ShopConfigV2 contentsParams (M2-00). No second configuration.

addOns.title: Starter set: committed NFTs and seed readiness before opening
addOns.status: M2: role 19 gates opening on exact set and seed readiness. Count zero requires hash zero; nonempty sets contain 10..10000 items. No NFT pull at creation. SHOP only: a PILE seed uses its contentsParams and the pile itself as role 19, without this add-on.

params.name: setHash
params.what: Ordered collection/id/tier chain root; zero exactly when count is zero.

params.name: count
params.what: Zero for a seed-only gate, otherwise 10..10000 committed items.

requires.why: Only an empty zero-hash commitment or a nonempty 10..10000 item chain can be completed.

addOns.title: Earnings of held items: price-coin earnings feed this box
addOns.status: Reserved for M2; earned coins in another coin wait for a later version (F122 R36L). The royalty conversion Safe does not enable earned-coin conversions.

addOns.title: Humble creator: a cap on everything the creator takes, per 30 days
addOns.status: Refused in this release, even if a context offers it: ADD_ON_NOT_AVAILABLE at field 1000 (F119 R35B). Creator caps wait for a later version; the id and old parameter encoding are retained only to refuse old specs.

params.name: preset
params.what: Legacy preset id; add-on 10 is refused before its params are read.

notInFormat2.why: Box 0 only (format 1, version 1); item payouts are M3's Items destination (box-spec-v2-draft.md § 1, § 6). ADD_ON_UNKNOWN in format 2.
Format 1 only. No creator cap is offered in this v2 release (F119); ADD_ON_UNKNOWN. Add-on 10 remains known but unavailable.
